regression_triage.source: /qa-triage-results basis — the per-case classification lives at regression.c1.case_triage

not_defects.item: Loyalty points are taxed — required is the cart total INCLUDING 20% tax (40,000 subtotal -> required 48000)
not_defects.ruling: NOT A DEFECT against any existing oracle. BL-LOY-003 establishes that cart.cartTotals[] carries one entry per line currency EACH WITH ITS OWN taxTotal, and BL-CHK-006's total formula includes TaxTotal — so the platform INTENDS a tax figure per currency leg, and the arithmetic is internally consistent. What is genuinely open is the PRODUCT question: should a points redemption attract tax at all? No BL-* invariant and no domain-map section addresses it. Routed as a spec question with a named owner (the implementer), not as a bug. If the answer is no, required is overstated by 20% on every redemption.

Both no-data paths are guarded (new unsaved org -> widget absent via isVisible: !e.isNew; bogus org id -> the member GET fails first and the workspace is blank). The pre-existing contact widget is structurally identical — the new widget copied the pattern. Needs a permission-restricted admin to reproduce. Recorded as an open verification gap, explicitly not a pass.

resolved_in_fix_round.action: REPAIRED — re-based to FOLLOW BL-LOY-018 instead of contradicting it, plus the missing premise guard.
resolved_in_fix_round.target_changed: from ORG_LOY_MISSION (OrderCountGoal count 1) to @td(ORG_LOY_MISSION_PARTIAL.id) (count 2, reward 631). A count-1 target is Completed the instant anything accrues, so every later read compares two values pinned before the case acted — which is exactly how the 2026-09-16 run produced a vacuous PASS. A count-2 target leaves ONE order at 1 of 2, InProgress and still movable, so the follow-up read is a MEASUREMENT.
resolved_in_fix_round.orchestrator_error_caught_by_doer: The orchestrator proposed asserting on mission 01a0a9ea-20a5-7861-a997-0336bf5a8710 (the one observed moving 648 -> 5,987.99). It has NO @td() alias, so that would have put a raw GUID literal into a suite CSV — forbidden by test-data.md and caught by DV-013/DV-021. The doer refused and substituted an aliased target that answers the same question.
resolved_in_fix_round.assertion_now_bounded_both_ends: B delta < 1 => user-keyed => FAIL; B delta > 1 => one order counted per member, violating BL-LOY-018 unconditional clause => FAIL; exactly 1 => one shared row, one contribution => PASS. The old `≈ {{B_VALUE_BEFORE}}` could distinguish none of the three on a terminal row.
resolved_in_fix_round.guard_added: [DATA label=progress_a] currentValue - {{A_VALUE_BEFORE}} ≈ 1 {BL} — A own progress must MOVE before B is compared. If it does not, the accrual never ran and the case is BLOCKED, never PASS. This is the assertion whose absence let the run compare 1 to 1 and call it green.
resolved_in_fix_round.residual_risk_stated: The delta assertions need loyaltyMissionProgress to return a row with currentValue 0 for a targeted-but-unstarted mission. If rows are instead created lazily on first accrual, the captures resolve empty — converted into a NAMED BLOCKED by the leading [COUNT] length = 1 guard rather than an unexplained arithmetic error. First live re-run settles it.

HOLDS — and this is the VCST-5953 fix, verified RED->GREEN. Falsifiability test: a cart inflated until required exceeded the balance made the validator FIRE with required=48000, available=33872.0000 — equal to the figure the same actor is shown on their own account page. VIOLATED, on two separate surfaces. (1) Storefront/xAPI: LoyaltyOperationLog exposes no member field at any layer, so a pooled row cannot be attributed by any consumer — a 4-column table (Operation|Type|Date|Amount) shows a colleague's order number with nothing marking it as not the viewer's own. (2) Back office: the contact-level filter returns 0 and is silently ignored when combined with organizationId, and every user-scoped aggregate reads 0. PARTIAL MITIGATION, recorded because it narrows the finding: attribution IS reachable at the admin layer per MISSION — every grant row carries sourceType/sourceId, and search {sourceId} returns exactly the causing row. What is unreachable is per-MEMBER.

HOLDS, as DECLARED COST. Progress is keyed on the owner, which is the ORGANIZATION under this store mode, so A and B share one row and A's completion consumes the mission for the company. The invariant names that explicitly as "not a violation of this rule but its declared cost". Evidenced on mission 631 (target 2): createdBy=A, modifiedBy=B, currentValue 1->2, one grant attributed to B. This settles the implementer's open 2026-09-02 question.
ABSENT IN PRODUCT, unchanged and not re-filed. No reversal path exists for a loyalty accrual. This change widens the blast radius from one person's balance to a pool any member can spend.

Consulted for the points-taxation question and found NOT to make it a defect — cartTotals carries a per-currency taxTotal and the total formula includes TaxTotal, so the platform intends a tax figure per currency leg. Routed as a spec question, not a bug.

The org-membership lock IS enforced, upstream at org-scope resolution / token mint rather than in the loyalty authorization handler. NOTE: the three-state flip establishing causality has NO SAVED PAYLOAD (5b re-verify F2) — the claim is recorded but not artifacted, and the 5b gate declined to accept it on that basis.
